title: Privacy First Enterprise AI: Building AI Agents that Never Leave Your Security Boundary
talk_summary: The talk argues that enterprise AI agents should be deployed inside existing security boundaries and managed like employees through existing identity, permissions, audit, and communication systems rather than new portals. It gives a high-level pattern for using Microsoft 365/Entra/email-style infrastructure, but cites no measured efficiency or quality results.

takeaways.what_they_do: Provision AI agents as employee-like accounts in existing identity systems, then apply standard security policies, permissions, and audit tooling.
takeaways.evidence_quote: IT teams can create agent accounts using their existing active directory tools apply standard security policies

takeaways.what_they_do: Use an existing logged communication channel such as email for agent coordination so permissions and data flows are automatically auditable.
takeaways.evidence_quote: our AI agents can email each other to share data and coordinate work every interaction is fully logged and auditable

takeaways.technique: Reuse hardened systems instead of new portals
takeaways.what_they_do: Deliver AI capabilities through existing trusted enterprise systems to inherit their security, compliance, and workflow controls.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we can leverage existing Enterprise infrastructure rather than building parallel systems
